verdict.rationale: Navan's own API documents batch operations: a batch update via PATCH across expense transactions and batch management of custom-field option values with async job status polling. These are only one-line mentions, and the MCP server is described only for querying and analysis, not bulk write actions by AI assistants. Missing for 10: batch limits and semantics, bulk actions through the MCP/AI-assistant interface, bulk operations beyond expenses and custom fields (e.g., travel/bookings), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: batch-manage option values, and poll async job status
